newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer across the board on Tuesday, supported by technical buying, traders said.

Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.0 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.5 yen higher at 140.4 yen. Volume was thin with only 4,422 lots traded, as most private investors retreated to the sidelines.

The market opened weaker, pressured by the yen's firmer tone against the dollar. But relatively lower prices here compared with overseas rubber markets prompted Japanese trade houses to cover their short positions, the traders said.
